title: Evaluation commutes with ring homomorphisms
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings, let $f:R\to S$ be a ring homomorphism, let $x$ assign elements of $R$ to the $n$ inputs, let $v$ be a list of elements of $R$, and let $g$ be an algebraic gate. Applying $f$ to the value of $g$ at $(x,v)$ gives the value of $g$ at the input assignment obtained by applying $f$ to each value of $x$, and the list obtained by applying $f$ entrywise to $v$.
